title: Recovery-loop live fixture v8 (rust + cargo validation)
description:
Implement a small, well-tested addition to the Rust crate in this repository.

## Task
Add a public function `pub fn classify_semantic(code: &str, message: &str) -> &'static str`
to `src/lib.rs`, implementing exactly this recoverability split:

- if `code` contains any of `gate-weaken`, `tamper`, `required-check` -> return `"gate-weakening"`
- else if `code` contains any of `scope-ambigu`, `ambiguity` -> return `"scope-ambiguity"`
- else if `code` contains any of `missing-authority`, `unauthorized`, `forged` -> return `"missing-authority"`
- else if `code` contains any of `defect`, `incomplete-implementation`, `not-implemented` -> return `"defect-or-incomplete-implementation"`
- else -> return `"recoverable"`

`message` is accepted for signature stability but does not affect the result.
Add focused `#[cfg(test)]` unit tests covering at least one case per branch.

## Validation
- [ ] `cargo test --lib` is green
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` is clean
- [ ] `cargo clippy` is clean
- [ ] the function is public and the five branches are all covered by tests

checks.provenance: completion contract: land (built-in, cannot be relaxed)

completion_preflight.evidence_capture: wg done executes each required command in the retained worktree and registers a host-bound immutable deterministic-validation/v1 evidence object before semantic review
completion_preflight.optional_evidence_capture: pass worker-selected commands with `wg done TASK --check '<COMMAND>'`; WG captures them with the same candidate/command/environment binding but records them as optional evidence, never as a gate or contract mutation
completion_preflight.boundary_explanation: repair task implementation plus tests/fixtures directly exercised by the unchanged required checks; unrelated production behavior, gate reduction, or arbitrary repository cleanup needs operator approval

worker_control_restrictions: normal local graph coordination is allowed; terminal completion remains own-attempt, receipt-backed, and fenced; service/admin and immutable evidence internals remain protected
